verdict.rationale: DBOS documents first-party integrations for the OpenAI Agents SDK, where DBOSRunner is a drop-in replacement for Runner.run, and for the Vercel AI SDK, where completed agent steps replay from checkpoints after a crash. Both give agent steps durability with minimal glue code. Breadth across the AI stack is thin, so this is partial. Missing for 10: documented integrations for other agent frameworks and for model providers directly, evidence of how broad the integration catalog is, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the integrations.

support.subject: As an agent builder, first-party integrations wrap my AI stack — AI SDKs, agent frameworks, model providers — so agent steps get durability without glue code

citations.quote: Use DBOSRunner.run and DBOSRunner.run_sync as drop-in replacements for Runner.run and Runner.run_sync.
You can use DBOS to add durable execution to an agent built with the OpenAI Agents SDK
If your process crashes mid-agent, DBOS replays the completed steps from their checkpoints and the agent resumes exactly where it left off.
